goal: Determine whether validated Rust cuda-oxide operation proofs are wired into the production CUDA runtime before permitting default-route promotion or C CUDA removal.
validated_operation_families: M14.1 cuda-oxide substrate and tensor residency
M14.2 embedding, indexer, and elementwise kernels
M14.3 dense projection, quantization, and norm kernels
M14.4 RoPE, KV, compressor, and attention kernels
M14.5 router, routed-MoE, and hyperconnection kernels

blockers: rust/ds4-gpu/build.rs still compiles and archives ds4_cuda.cu for the Linux CUDA backend
rust/ds4-gpu does not depend on rust/ds4-cuda and rust/ds4-cuda does not export the ds4_gpu ABI
rust/ds4-engine still rejects the runtime graph route instead of executing a Rust CUDA backend
decision.next_required_stage: M14.6b Rust CUDA ABI Backend Assembly

validation.b300_test_command: CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup PATH=/tmp/cargo/bin:$PATH LIBCLANG_PATH=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu CUDA_HOME=/usr/local/cuda-13.2 RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=nightly-2026-04-03 cargo test --locked -p ds4-cuda --features cuda-oxide-backend -- --nocapture
